vertebrae.execution.distributed
===============================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.execution.distributed

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Distributed embedding primitives.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: embedding_artifact_key(dataset, extractor)

   Build the canonical embedding artifact key.

   :param dataset: Dataset object with a `fingerprint()` method.
   :param extractor: Feature extractor with a serializable `recipe()`.

   :returns: Artifact key for the complete embedding matrix.


.. py:function:: embedding_shard_key(base_key, shard)

   Build an artifact key for one embedding shard.

   :param base_key: Complete embedding artifact key.
   :param shard: Deterministic shard assignment.

   :returns: Artifact key for the shard.


.. py:function:: labels_artifact_key(dataset)

   Build the canonical label artifact key.

   :param dataset: Dataset object with a `fingerprint()` method.

   :returns: Artifact key for labels.


.. py:function:: scoring_artifact_key(embedding_key, seed = None)

   Build a scoring artifact key.

   :param embedding_key: Complete embedding artifact key.
   :param seed: Optional scoring seed.

   :returns: Artifact key for scoring output.


.. py:function:: plan_embedding_shard_jobs(dataset, extractor, total_shards, batch_size = 128)

   Create deterministic embedding shard jobs.

   :param dataset: Dataset to embed.
   :param extractor: Feature extractor to run on each shard.
   :param total_shards: Number of non-overlapping shards to create.
   :param batch_size: Number of samples per transform batch.

   :returns: Embedding shard jobs with canonical output keys.


.. py:function:: materialize_embedding_shards(jobs, store, execution)

   Materialize embedding shards with an execution backend.

   :param jobs: Embedding shard jobs.
   :param store: Artifact store receiving shard outputs.
   :param execution: Backend with a `map()` method, such as `LocalBackend`.

   :returns: Shard manifests in job order.


.. py:function:: materialize_and_merge_embeddings(dataset, extractor, store, execution, total_shards, batch_size = 128)

   Materialize sharded embeddings and merge them into one artifact.

   :param dataset: Dataset to embed.
   :param extractor: Feature extractor to run.
   :param store: Artifact store for shard and merged artifacts.
   :param execution: Backend used to materialize shard jobs.
   :param total_shards: Number of deterministic sample shards.
   :param batch_size: Number of samples per transform batch.

   :returns: Merged embedding manifest.


.. py:function:: materialize_label_artifact(dataset, store, key = None)

   Materialize dataset labels as an artifact.

   :param dataset: Dataset with labels.
   :param store: Artifact store receiving labels.
   :param key: Optional artifact key. Defaults to `labels_artifact_key(dataset)`.

   :returns: JSON-compatible label manifest.


.. py:function:: score_embedding_artifact(job, store)

   Score a persisted embedding artifact against persisted labels.

   :param job: Scoring job.
   :param store: Artifact store containing inputs and receiving the score.

   :returns: JSON-compatible scoring artifact.


.. py:function:: score_embedding_artifacts(jobs, store, execution)

   Score persisted embeddings with an execution backend.

   :param jobs: Scoring jobs.
   :param store: Artifact store containing inputs and receiving outputs.
   :param execution: Backend with a `map()` method.

   :returns: Scoring artifacts in job order.


.. py:function:: validate_embedding_label_artifacts(store, embedding_key, labels_key)

   Validate that embedding and label artifacts can be scored together.

   :param store: Artifact store containing the artifacts.
   :param embedding_key: Complete embedding artifact key.
   :param labels_key: Label artifact key.

   :returns: Embedding and label manifests.

   :raises ValueError: If metadata is incompatible.


.. py:function:: plan_scoring_jobs(embedding_key, labels_key, seeds, scoring_config = None)

   Create scoring jobs for one embedding and label artifact pair.

   :param embedding_key: Complete embedding artifact key.
   :param labels_key: Label artifact key.
   :param seeds: Seeds for scoring jobs. Use `None` for the default single score.
   :param scoring_config: Optional scoring configuration shared by all jobs.

   :returns: Scoring jobs with canonical output keys.


.. py:function:: collect_score_artifacts(score_keys, store, output_key, interval_level = 0.95)

   Collect scoring artifacts into a stability-style summary.

   :param score_keys: Score artifact keys to aggregate.
   :param store: Artifact store containing score artifacts.
   :param output_key: Artifact key for the collection summary.
   :param interval_level: Percentile interval level for summary statistics.

   :returns: JSON-compatible score collection artifact.


.. py:function:: benchmark_result_from_artifacts(score_key, store, output_key = None, stability_key = None)

   Build and optionally persist a benchmark-style result from artifacts.

   :param score_key: Score artifact key.
   :param store: Artifact store containing score and source artifacts.
   :param output_key: Optional result artifact key.
   :param stability_key: Optional score collection key to use as stability metadata.

   :returns: JSON-compatible benchmark result.


.. py:function:: materialize_embedding_shard(job, store)

   Materialize one embedding shard artifact.

   :param job: Embedding shard job.
   :param store: Artifact store receiving the shard.

   :returns: JSON-compatible shard manifest.

   :raises ValueError: If the extractor emits invalid embeddings.


.. py:function:: merge_embedding_shards(job, store)

   Merge embedding shard artifacts into a complete embedding artifact.

   :param job: Embedding merge job.
   :param store: Artifact store containing shards and receiving the merge.

   :returns: JSON-compatible merged embedding manifest.

   :raises ValueError: If shard metadata is inconsistent, duplicated, or incomplete.
